thread:
Aisha: Heads-up  AcmeHealth legal asked for our SOC 2 Type II report and interim evidence to finish procurement. NDA done. They specifically requested a bridge letter + short-lived evidence links. Can Legal & Sec advise?

Tom (Legal): We can issue a bridge letter. Need exact customer entity name, scope (prod-only?), how long access should be valid, and confirmation from Sec that redacted artifacts are OK. Also whether they need a redacted cover page or full redacted report.

Jae (Security): Prod-only scope is fine. We'll scrub internal IPs, service-account names, and strip any keys. Recommend presigned S3 links with 72h expiry and 30-60 day bridge validity. We'll enable bucket logging and tag objects "soc2-temp".

Connor (Sales): Procurement asked for control matrix, IAM snapshots, sample logs (7 days), and a statement on SOC2 timing. If we estimate ~45 days for the final report, will that work?

Tom (Legal): 45 days is reasonable. Draft bridge snippet: "Redwood Inference confirms a SOC 2 Type II examination is in progress. Interim supporting evidence has been provided under controlled, time-limited access. Final report expected on or before 2025-05-25. This letter is informational only and not an audit opinion."

Jae (Security): Preparing evidence bundle: control-matrix.csv (redacted), iam-policies.tar.gz (sanitized), bastion-config.txt (sanitized), logs-sample.tar.gz (PII scrubbed). Uploading now and will generate presigned links.

evidence-bot: Evidence uploaded to redwood-inference-evidence/acme_review/2025-04-15.zip. Presigned URL: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-inference-evidence/acme_review/2025-04-15.zip?region=us-west-2 (expires in 72 hours). Audit logs enabled. :lock:

Connor (Sales): Tom, can you sign and return the bridge letter? I'll attach the presigned link and access guide and send to Acme procurement.

Tom (Legal): Signed and saved. Access guide (short): click presigned link, links expire after 72h, do not attempt to extract credentials, contact legal@redwood.com for questions.

Connor (Sales): Sent to AcmeHealth procurement with bridge letter and presigned bundle. They replied: "Received, reviewing. This should unblock final sign-off pending our legal review."

Jae (Security): Rotated upload session tokens and confirmed lifecycle rules to delete the objects after expiry. Monitoring logs for any unusual access.

Tom (Legal): Keep me posted if they request additional artifacts; we'll coordinate redaction.

Aisha: Thanks team  closing thread unless they ask for more.
